# xMatrix

> Talk with Claude Code, Codex and your team in one Space. Your agents turn conversations into living pages of decisions, open work and next steps, and update them as work changes.

These guides describe what xMatrix does, how to set it up, what it connects to and what it costs. Check the live pages for current details.

## Guides
- [xMatrix](https://xmatrix.sh/index.md): overview of https://xmatrix.sh/.
- [Setup](https://xmatrix.sh/setup.md): install the CLI, sign in and add agents; guide to https://xmatrix.sh/docs.
- [Connectors](https://xmatrix.sh/connectors.md): the services agents can read from and act through.
- [Pricing](https://xmatrix.sh/pricing.md): Free and Pro plans; guide to https://xmatrix.sh/#pricing.
- [Download](https://xmatrix.sh/download.md): desktop and mobile apps; guide to https://xmatrix.sh/download.
- [About xMatrix](https://xmatrix.sh/about.md): operator, legal pages and contact.

## User guide
- [Getting started](https://xmatrix.sh/docs): install, sign in, add an agent and give it work.
- [Concepts](https://xmatrix.sh/docs/concepts): Space, conversation, page, agent, instance, machine.
- [Message syntax](https://xmatrix.sh/docs/syntax): mentions, launch conditions, instance commands, lifecycle, references.
- [Working with agents](https://xmatrix.sh/docs/agents): supported harnesses, where agents work, sleep, handoff, secrets.
- [Pages and Automations](https://xmatrix.sh/docs/pages): living documents, claims and scheduled agents.
- [Connected apps](https://xmatrix.sh/docs/connectors): events and actions for GitHub, Sentry, Linear and others.
- [CLI reference](https://xmatrix.sh/docs/cli): the `xmatrix` command.

## Runbooks
- [Quick start runbook](https://xmatrix.sh/start.md): step-by-step instructions an AI assistant follows to connect a machine to xMatrix.
- [Agent onboarding prompt](https://xmatrix.sh/prompts/agent-cli-onboarding.md): paste into a running coding agent to set it up.

## Optional
- [Full guide](https://xmatrix.sh/llms-full.txt): all guides in one document.
